history.content: How do I build a database-driven Slackbot?

To create a database-driven Slackbot, you can use the tutorial named "Build a database-driven Slackbot" (<https://cloud.ibm.com/docs/solution-tutorials?topic=solution-tutorials-slack-chatbot-database-watson>). This tutorial will walk you through the process of developing a Slackbot that enables you to search and create entries in a backend Db2 on Cloud database. The Slackbot is supported by the IBM Watson® Assistant service, and you will connect Slack and IBM Watson® Assistant using an Assistant integration. Db2 on Cloud is provided to Watson Assistant as a custom extension. Additionally, the tutorial includes instructions for building and deploying a Python database app to Code Engine.

The objectives of building a database-driven Slackbot using the provided tutorial are:
1. Construct a chatbot using IBM Watson® Assistant that interacts with a database backend.
2. Connect Watson Assistant to Slack using an integration.
3. Create and deploy a Python database app to Code Engine.
4. Access a Db2 on Cloud database via a Watson Assistant custom extension.
